robustness: Euclidean20% trimming versus no trimming; independently add Huber weights to either retained set. Fixed20mm engineering scale, not estimated sensor noise; no B-driven tuning. IRLS initialized by LS, three reweightings on the same correspondence set.
sampling: Original16384 face/barycentric anchors.256 exact original linspace subset,1024 adds768 uniformly indexed members of its complement,4096 adds3072 members of remaining complement. Nested sets; budgets are BEFORE visibility filtering, not guaranteed visible counts.
correspondence: Original CUDA float32 query-ray Z sampling, nearest align_corners=True, original affine and64px side trim. Recompute source valid/mask, pixel projection and nvdiffrast mesh self-visibility at EVERY outer step. Original20mm self-visibility tolerance; this is not an observed-depth residual rejection threshold.
solver: Translation only. Point-plane least squares on mesh normals, SVD rcond1e-6 minimum norm. Gate is separate eigenvalue attenuation lambda/(lambda+0.01), not combined with robustness. No learned weights, angle weights, rotation or free vertices.
fallback: At each reported1/2/3/6-step endpoint, excessive total raw correction returns to original internal Coarse. Zero observed queries produces zero step, logged; all frames retained.
evaluation: Reuse R52 exact fixed B points, transforms, point-to-triangle evaluator and Native corresponding GT evaluation. All A-only solutions complete before full B evaluation. References copied from SHA-verified R52 fits and re-evaluated, not re-fitted.
aggregation: BEHAVE K1/K2/K3 within-frame equal mean; frame -> sequence -> identity equal means, separately by cohort and seed. Report each seed, mean/sample SD, P95, coverage and failures. No overall pooled dataset score.
primary_contrast: proj_plane3 versus proj_med3 (same reprojection, trimming,256budget and caps). Steps1/2/3/6; gate/robustness/density are secondary prespecified contrasts, not winner selection.
TEST: No sealed Native/HuMMan TEST. BEHAVE is a previously consumed official-test subset, not new unseen validation.
scope: Finite diagnostic only. No automatic learned solver or R6. Existing known B development evidence informed this proposal; no claim of untouched confirmatory testing or exact upper bound. No speed/clinical/novelty guarantee.
